claims.subject: BF range and its effect on eta_C*
claims.object: 51-65% in Hwang et al. versus about 70-85% in Ryu et al.; weak BF effect on eta_C* in Hwang's range
claims.statement: The BF interval in Hwang et al. was 51-65%, about 20% lower than Ryu's 70-85%; raising BF by 14% from 51% increased eta_C* by at most 0.74% (A03 ring), whereas Ryu et al. reported a 3.85% rise from 92.63% for a 15% BF increase from 70%.
